issues.claim: Реляционные шаблоны (`<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=` с константой) появились в C# 9.
issues.problem: The fetched excerpt of the patterns page does not state the C# 9 version. The claim is correct (relational patterns arrived in C# 9), and the generic C# version history article is not cited.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally cite the C# 9 what's-new page or the relational patterns section of the C# specification for the version claim. No change to the text is needed.

issues.claim: Two delegates for the same method with the same target are equal, so `B` is found and removed.
issues.problem: The claim is true, because Delegate.Equals compares method and target. The cited Delegate.Remove excerpt only describes removal of the last matching occurrence and never states how equality is defined, so no linked page backs this specific sentence.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add a link to https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.delegate.equals, or word the sentence as 'delegates with the same method and target compare equal (Delegate.Equals)'.
